plausibilityWarnings.message: Thunderheart Harness 4pc reports 196.29 DPS — ~9.1% of a 2152.10 baseline, above the 7.5% plausibility band. Treat as a suspected confound, not a bonus this large; check what the package breaks.
Nordrassil Harness 4pc reports 185.10 DPS — ~8.6% of a 2152.10 baseline, above the 7.5% plausibility band. Treat as a suspected confound, not a bonus this large; check what the package breaks.
